headline: [Gaza Strike] Israel Kills Hamas Rafah Brigade Chief [Samir Abu Younis]
sub: Hamas confirms death; strike hit Khan Younis
caption:
📍 Gaza Strike Israel Kills Hamas Rafah Brigade Chief Samir Abu Younis

Israel's military says it carried out a strike on Saturday that targeted a senior commander of Hamas's armed wing in Khan Younis, southern Gaza. Hamas confirmed that Samir Abu Younis, the commander of its Rafah brigade, was killed. Medics said the strike hit the Mawasi area and wounded others.

🔹 Abu Younis, 53, had been a member of Hamas's armed wing, the Al-Qassam Brigades, since 1991, Reuters reported.
🔹 Gaza health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire began. Five Israeli soldiers have died in the same period.
🔹 The ceasefire stopped major fighting, but strikes have continued and Hamas has not disarmed.
